summary: Conversion opening AP is a liability carried through the cutoff, not a payment instruction (Canyon Gate: 12 opening items, $7,992.75, appeared in Bills ready to pay; 9, $2,134.19, were already paid by ACH). Adds opening_ap_payment_clearances (append-only decisions: cleared_for_payment with check/ach and a basis, or revoked; latest per invoice wins), which the application guard reads before any payment of an opening AP invoice. ap_invoices.status gains 'conversion_review', the review state future conversions write opening AP in. A BEFORE INSERT trigger makes any invoice born posted by a conversion opening entry carry its vendor's auto-pay flag and start in 'conversion_review'. Changes no existing row; writes no clearance.

preflight.name: the status CHECK being replaced is named ap_invoices_status_check (177 inline default)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'ap_invoices'::regclass AND conname = 'ap_invoices_status_check'

preflight.name: every existing invoice status is one the widened CHECK still allows
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM ap_invoices WHERE status NOT IN ('awaiting_approval', 'approved', 'partially_paid', 'paid', 'voided', 'disputed', 'on_hold', 'conversion_review')

preflight.name: opening_ap_payment_clearances does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'opening_ap_payment_clearances'

preflight.name: vendors.auto_pay_ach exists (267)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendors' AND column_name = 'auto_pay_ach'

preflight.name: no onboarding batch is mid-execute
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM conversion_batches WHERE onboarding_stage = 'execute' AND status <> 'posted'

expected_changes: Creates opening_ap_payment_clearances (invoice, community, decision cleared_for_payment / revoked, payment_method check / ach required on a clearance and absent on a revocation, basis of 10+ characters, evidence jsonb, decided_by, created_at). FKs RESTRICT; index (invoice_id, created_at); a guard trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE and a decision whose community differs from the invoice's. RLS on; nothing for anon / authenticated; SELECT, INSERT to service_role.
Replaces ap_invoices_status_check: same name, the existing seven values plus conversion_review.

Adds ap_invoices_opening_ap_defaults + trg_ap_invoices_opening_ap_defaults (BEFORE INSERT on ap_invoices): an invoice whose posting entry has source_module 'opening_entry' gets is_ach_autopay OR its vendor's auto_pay_ach, and 'approved' / 'awaiting_approval' becomes 'conversion_review'. Inserts only; no existing row is touched.
No ap_invoices, journal_entries or vendors row changes; no clearance is written.

verify.name: the widened status CHECK allows conversion_review
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'ap_invoices'::regclass AND conname = 'ap_invoices_status_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%conversion_review%'

verify.name: clearances are append-only (guard trigger present)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_opening_ap_payment_clearances_guard'

verify.name: opening AP insert backstop present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_ap_invoices_opening_ap_defaults'

verify.name: service_role can read and insert clearances; anon and authenticated cannot read them
verify.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN has_table_privilege('service_role', 'opening_ap_payment_clearances', 'SELECT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'opening_ap_payment_clearances', 'INSERT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('anon', 'opening_ap_payment_clearances', 'SELECT') AND NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'opening_ap_payment_clearances', 'SELECT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int
